SELECT PT.CPNY_ID, PT.EMPID, E.LOCAL_NAME, PT.PA_MONTH, PT.EMP_TYPE_CODE, PT.PA_AREA_CD, PT.SALARY_ITEM, PT.SALARY_ITEM_FEE, PT.ADD_FLAG, UPLOAD_ERROR_MSG, LINE_ID, RESULT_FLAG, HE.LOCAL_NAME UPLOAD_BY, to_char(UPLOAD_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') UPLOAD_DATE FROM PA_SUMMARY_FSE PT, HR_EMPLOYEE HE, HR_EMPLOYEE E WHERE UPLOAD_BY = HE.PERSON_ID AND PT.EMPID = E.EMPID AND PT.CPNY_ID= E.CPNY_ID AND UPLOAD_BY = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#
PT.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
ORDER BY PT.CPNY_ID

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PA_SUMMARY_FSE PT, HR_EMPLOYEE HE, HR_EMPLOYEE E WHERE UPLOAD_BY = HE.PERSON_ID AND PT.EMPID = E.EMPID AND PT.CPNY_ID= E.CPNY_ID AND UPLOAD_BY = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#
PT.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
ORDER BY PT.CPNY_ID

SELECT PT.CPNY_ID, PT.EMPID, E.LOCAL_NAME, PT.PA_MONTH, PT.EMP_TYPE_CODE, PT.PA_AREA_CD, PT.SALARY_ITEM, PT.SALARY_ITEM_FEE, PT.ADD_FLAG, UPLOAD_ERROR_MSG, LINE_ID, RESULT_FLAG, HE.LOCAL_NAME UPLOAD_BY, to_char(UPLOAD_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') UPLOAD_DATE FROM PA_SUMMARY_FSE_TEMP PT, HR_EMPLOYEE HE, HR_EMPLOYEE E WHERE UPLOAD_BY = HE.PERSON_ID AND PT.EMPID = E.EMPID AND PT.CPNY_ID= E.CPNY_ID AND UPLOAD_BY = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#
RESULT_FLAG = #RESULT_FLAG#

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM PA_SUMMARY_FSE_TEMP PT, HR_EMPLOYEE HE, HR_EMPLOYEE E WHERE UPLOAD_BY = HE.PERSON_ID AND PT.EMPID = E.EMPID AND PT.CPNY_ID= E.CPNY_ID AND UPLOAD_BY = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#
RESULT_FLAG = #RESULT_FLAG#

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM PA_SUMMARY_FSE_TEMP PT, HR_EMPLOYEE HE, HR_EMPLOYEE E WHERE UPLOAD_BY = HE.PERSON_ID AND PT.EMPID = E.EMPID AND PT.CPNY_ID= E.CPNY_ID AND UPLOAD_BY = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# AND RESULT_FLAG = 'E'
